title: Graduate Town Planner
description:
Job Title: Graduate Town Planner

Ref: BM307

Location: Dover

Salary: 27,000 - 30,000

This is an excellent opportunity to join an independent Town Planning Consultancy that provide their expertise to the residential, leisure, retail, and commercial sectors. They are on the lookout for a talented and enthusiastic Graduate Town Planner to join their Macclesfield studio.

Benefits for the role of Graduate Town Planner include:
- Highly competitive salary
- Contributory pension scheme
- Generous holiday allowance
- Professional development
- Personal development

Duties for the role of Graduate Town Planner:
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications
- Supporting planning appraisals and development potential assessments
- Undertaking planning policy research and reviewing local planning documents
- Assisting with the preparation of planning statements, reports and representations
- Supporting senior colleagues with planning appeals and enforcement matters
- Assisting with development plan and Local Plan representations
- Liaising with local planning authorities and other professional consultants
- Undertaking site visits and gathering information to support planning advice
- Monitoring planning applications and progressing projects through the planning process

Requirements for the role of Graduate Town Planner:
- A degree in Town Planning, Urban Planning or a closely related discipline which is RTPI accredited
- A genuine interest in the UK planning system and development
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Good research and analytical abilities
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
- A proactive, positive and practical approach to problem solving
- The confidence to work collaboratively while also taking responsibility for your own workload
- A willingness to learn and develop professionally

title: Medical Receptionist
description:
Medical Receptionist

Location: Macclesfield
Contract: Temporary, initially 3 months (potential to extend up to 6 months)
Hours: Full Time, Monday to Friday, 08:30 - 17:00
Pay Rate: 12.71 - 13.50 per hour (dependent on experience)

Overview

We are currently recruiting for a Medical Receptionist to join a busy healthcare setting in Macclesfield. This is a full-time temporary position initially for 3 months, with the possibility of extension up to 6 months for the right candidate.

This is a front-facing role requiring excellent customer service, strong organisational skills, and the ability to work effectively within a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Greeting patients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner.
- Checking patients in for appointments and updating patient records where required.
- Providing directions and general assistance to patients and visitors.
- Managing incoming telephone calls and responding to enquiries.
- Booking, amending and cancelling appointments.
- Ensuring patient information is handled confidentially at all times.
- Maintaining accurate records and updating databases as required.
- Managing reception and waiting areas to ensure a welcoming and professional environment.
- Liaising with clinicians and other healthcare professionals.
- Undertaking general administrative and reception duties to support the wider team.

Person Specification
- Previous reception, administration, customer service, or medical reception experience preferred.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and internal computer systems.
- Professional, approachable, and patient-focused.
- Ability to work efficiently in a busy environment.
- High level of discretion and confidentiality.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Purchasing / Buying Administrator
description:
Purchasing / Buying Administrator

Location: Macclesfield, Cheshire, SK10 2 NZ
Salary: £26,000 £29,000 per annum, DOE
Contract: Full time, permanent

Why Join Us
- Be part of a growing and innovative company where your contributions will truly make a difference.
- Work in a hands-on role that offers a variety of challenges.
- Join a friendly and supportive team with a shared commitment to quality and excellence.
- Competitive salary based on experience
- 25 days holiday, free parking and company pension scheme.

Be Part of a Team Bringing Tomorrow s Electronics to Life!

Are you looking for a role where no two days are the same?

Do you enjoy being at the centre of operations, supporting different teams, and keeping things running smoothly If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Based at our headquarters in Macclesfield, Cheshire, we have a small multi-disciplined, dynamic team designing and manufacturing high-value robotic machines for testing PCBs (printed circuit boards).

The majority of our sales are to China and the USA, where we operate our own small factories and employ local teams to provide high-quality customer support.

RoBAT is firmly established as the leading company in this very specialised and niche marketplace. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a company at the forefront of industrial automation.

We are looking for a driven and well-organised individual to support our Purchasing, Office and Stores operations. This is a varied role where you ll work closely with our financial, operational and engineering teams.

You ll help manage stock, coordinate purchasing, support administrative activities across the company, and provide a key point of contact for both internal colleagues and external suppliers. Full training will be provided.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a hands-on, fast-paced environment and wants to grow their skills within an established, supportive team.

As our Purchasing / Buying Administrator you will:
- Manage requisitions and process purchase orders from quotation to delivery
- Liaise with suppliers and internal teams to resolve supply issues
- Coordinate domestic and international shipments (FedEx, UPS, DHL)
- Match delivery notes with purchase orders and record goods received in the ERP system
- Provide administrative support across all departments, including senior leadership
- Act as the first point of contact for phone calls, visitors, and incoming mail
- Maintain office supplies, manage filing, scanning, and data entry tasks
- Update internal records including holiday schedules, absence logs, and fire roll call lists
- Oversee daily operations of the parts store
- Monitor stock levels, reorder supplies and organise inventory
- Conduct regular stock counts and maintain accurate ERP records
- Ensure a clean, safe, and well-organised stores environment

In order to be successful in this role you must have:
- Highly organised, dependable, and detail-driven
- Self-motivated with strong initiative and follow-through
- Confident communicator, both written and verbal
- Proficient with computer systems including Microsoft Excel and ERP platforms
- Strong time-management skills with the ability to prioritise
- Comfortable managing multiple tasks at once
- Positive, collaborative, and eager to learn
- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities

It would be great if you had:
- Experience in administrative, purchasing, or stores roles
- Exposure to stock control or logistics processes

If you're passionate about mechanical fitting and assembly, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to contribute to the success of a cutting-edge company, we would love to hear from you!

No agencies please.

Click APPLY today and start your next career adventure with RoBAT Ltd

title: GP Receptionist/Administrator
description: Join Our Friendly GP Practice Team Broken Cross Surgery is a busy, patient-focused GP practice providing high-quality healthcare to our local community. We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised, and compassionate Receptionist/Administrator to join our dedicated team. This is a varied and rewarding role that combines front-line patient contact with administrative support. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring our patients receive an excellent service while supporting the smooth running of the practice. Main Duties and Responsibilities As a Receptionist/Administrator, you duties will include: Welcome patients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner. Answer incoming telephone calls and deal with patient enquiries efficiently. Book, amend and cancel appointments using the practice clinical system. Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence. Scan, file and maintain accurate electronic patient records. Liaise with GPs, nurses and other healthcare professionals. Handle confidential patient information in accordance with GDPR and NHS requirements. Support a variety of administrative functions within the practice. We are looking for someone who: Essential Has excellent customer service and communication skills. Is confident using computer systems and Microsoft Office applications. Can remain calm and professional when working in a busy environment. Has strong organisational and multitasking abilities. Demonstrates attention to detail and accuracy. Works well both independently and as part of a team. Understands the importance of confidentiality. Can provide flexibility to cover additional hours for colleague leave and absence. Desirable Previous experience in a GP practice, NHS, healthcare or reception setting. Experience using EMIS Web or other clinical systems. Knowledge of NHS primary care services. Experience handling confidential information. We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised, and compassionate Receptionist/Administrator to join our dedicated team. Job Types: Permanent, Part-time Pay: £13.33 per hour Expected hours: 18 hours per week
